text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking along a tree-lined street……
Rrrroooaaar!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaat?! Someone actually dodged
Windy-chan's chomp-attack――?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Windy-chan is a baddie, so no matter what anyone says, I'm not listening and I won't lose~~!
choice_data_list: Still, depending on the opponent, that could end terribly――

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
!! Those footsteps mean our next prey is here!
All righty, this time it's gonna be a massive success!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Now's our chance! CHOMP!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nishi-shi! A total chomp-tastic success!
Now, be terrified! I'm gonna bite ya even more!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Kieeeh?! You're giving me even more rewards?!
What supreme fan service! Such divine bliss!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
........Wh... Why are you looking happy?!
Does biting... not work on this guy...?!
choice_data_list: It turned out just as you said.
It turned out just as you said.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
........Wh... Why are you looking happy?!
Does biting... not work on this guy...?!
choice_data_list: It turned out just as you said.
It turned out just as you said.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gnuuugh... Windy gets it, nanoda.
Things could get crazy depending on who it is, after all...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'll choose my opponent and bite right into them!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa... Mischievous and super cuteee...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Shinko Windy learned
completely the wrong lesson.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I-I would never admit it... NEVER, nodaa--!
No regrets, no second thoughts! I refuse to lose, nodaa!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Graaarr!! Roar, roar! Rrrrraaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...U t t e r l y... a d o r a b l e――

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It collapsed?! Yahoo! I wooooon~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, she showed zero remorse and kept snapping at people...
until dorm leader Hishi Amazon gave her a ferocious earful.
...Or so the rumors went a few days later.
